messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Please find the link to the completion bible for the Brampton transaction. Could you confirm the schedule of post-completion undertakings by Friday?

Marcus

--- I think this has come to me in error; I'm not acting on Brampton. You may have meant a colleague. Sarah ---
